content.introduction: Comprehensive Tune Break damage calculation formula for Wuthering Waves.

sections.title: Tune Break Base Value
sections.description: Fixed base value for Tune Break damage calculation:
sections.note: This value is constant and does not change based on character stats.

sections.title: Tune Break Multiplier
sections.description: Skill-specific multiplier for Tune Break damage:
details: Each Tune Break skill has its own multiplier value
This value is defined per skill and varies between characters
Check individual skill descriptions for exact multiplier values
sections.note: Tune Break Multiplier is determined by the specific skill being used.

sections.title: Tune Break Boost
sections.description: Tune Break Boost multiplier from various sources:
sections.formula: Tune Break Boost = (100 + Additional Tune Break Boost) / 100
details: Additional bonus is added as integer value
Final result is divided by 100 to convert to multiplier

sections.title: RES Multiplier
sections.description: Resistance calculation based on enemy resistance (same formula as normal damage):
sections.formula: Piecewise function based on Res_Tot value
details: Tune Break Skills deal Physical damage by default
Some Tune Break Rupture-type Skills have their own elemental attribute
Check individual skill descriptions for the correct element type
sections.note: Important: Apply the correct elemental resistance based on the skill type (Physical for standard Tune Break, or the specific element for Rupture-type skills).

sections.title: DEF Multiplier
sections.description: Defense calculation formula (same as normal damage):
sections.formula: DEF Multiplier = (800 + 8 × Lvl_char) / (800 + 8 × Lvl_char + (792 + 8 × Lvl_Enemy) × (1 - Def_ignr) × (1 - Def_red))
conditions: Def_ignr: Defense ignore ratio (e.g., 0.3 for 30% ignore)

sections.title: Tune DMG Bonus
sections.description: Sum of all Tune DMG Bonus:
sections.formula: Tune DMG Bonus = 1 + Sum of Tune DMG Bonus

sections.title: Tune Crit Multiplier
sections.description: Expected critical hit multiplier for Tune Break. If there is no separate crit value, it is 1.0.
sections.formula: Tune Crit = 1 + Tune Crit Rate × (Tune Crit DMG - 1)

sections.title: Repeat
sections.description: Number of times the same Tune Break occurs repeatedly. Default is 1.
sections.formula: Final Damage = (Single Tune Break Damage) × Repeat Count
